about.heading: About Me
description: I’m a self-taught developer with a background in communications who found a sustainable way to support my growing family through web and software development.
Relationships mean everything to me — from my wife and kids to my extended family, my brothers in Youth Apostles, and my coworkers at Apple FCU.
I’ve worked across a wide range of systems, tech stacks, and organizations, and I’m ready to take on any project that helps people connect and create something meaningful online.

history.title: Ministry and communications
history.detail: Worked in ministry and communications roles for the USCCB, the Basilica of St. Mary, and others.

history.title: First client sites
history.detail: Built my first sites for clients, including a family-owned flower farm.

history.title: Developer at Apple FCU
history.detail: Joined Apple Federal Credit Union full time, where I still work today.

history.title: Merger status page
history.detail: Built the page members used to track the NextMark systems conversion.
